name: Computer Science A AP: Bytelet
subtitle: Trace Java code, pop the stack
shortDescription: Practice the Java you will see on the exam: trace real code, fix every miss on your stack, and rehearse free-response questions with point-by-point scoring.
longDescription:
Bytelet is an independent study app for the AP Computer Science A exam. Every question is about real Java, and every answer to a code question was checked by actually running the code.

HOW IT WORKS
Miss a question and it lands on your stack. Pop the stack to drill that topic again with a fresh question. Nothing slips through, and a frame that keeps defeating you sinks to the bottom so you are never trapped.

WHAT YOU GET
- All 4 units and 53 topics of the course: using objects and methods, selection and iteration, class creation, data collections.
- 179 multiple-choice questions, each with a full written solution and a reason for every wrong choice.
- 8 original free-response questions in the four exam styles (methods and control structures, class design, ArrayList, 2D array) with point-by-point rubrics, model answers and a self-scoring checklist.
- Trace stepper: watch real programs run line by line with the true variable values.
- Number lab and String lab: integer division, remainder, overflow, substring, indexOf and compareTo, Java style.
- Quick check (12 questions) and a full mock: 42 questions in 90 minutes, then 4 free-response questions in 90 minutes, with a rough 1 to 5 estimate.
- Text size controls (A- and A+), works offline, no account.

FREE, WITH OPTIONAL AD-FREE
The app is free and shows ads. Watch an optional video to earn credits for extra practice. A monthly ad-free subscription removes the ads and nothing else: $3.99 per month with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Cancel anytime; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period.
